title: Lionel Messi at the World Cup
description: The little magician's long road to World Cup glory.

questions.q: In which year did Messi finally win the World Cup?
questions.explain: Messi led Argentina to the title in Qatar 2022.

questions.q: Messi has won the World Cup Golden Ball (best player) how many times?
questions.explain: He won it in 2014 and again in 2022 — the only player to win it twice.

questions.q: At which World Cup did Messi make his tournament debut?
questions.explain: Messi debuted as an 18-year-old in Germany 2006.

questions.q: Messi holds the record for most matches played at World Cups, with how many?
questions.explain: He reached 26 World Cup appearances in 2022.

questions.q: Argentina lost the 2014 final, with Messi on the team, to whom?
How many goals did Messi score in the 2022 tournament?
questions.explain: Messi scored seven goals on the way to the title.

questions.q: Which team stunned Messi's Argentina in their 2022 opener?
questions.explain: Saudi Arabia won 2–1 before Argentina recovered to win it all.

questions.q: Messi scored twice in the 2022 final. Who else scored for Argentina?
questions.explain: Di María scored Argentina's second in the 3–3 draw.

questions.q: How many World Cup tournaments has Messi appeared in?
questions.explain: Messi competed at five World Cups: 2006, 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022 — one of only a handful of players to appear in five editions.

questions.q: At the 2014 World Cup, Messi won which individual award despite Argentina losing the final?
questions.explain: Messi was controversially awarded the Golden Ball as the tournament's best player at Brazil 2014, even though Argentina lost the final 1–0 to Germany.
